question: In the process of solubilization by micelle formation:

options.opa: The Kraft point marks the transition between the solubility of an ionic surfactant in the form of ions or in the form of micelles.
options.opb: At concentrations of surfactants below the Critical Micellar Concentration (CMC) other structures that are liquid crystals are formed.
options.opc: The measurement of the intensity of light scattering decreases sharply from the CMC.
options.opd: The value of the CMC varies greatly the temperature since it is fundamentally an entropic process.
